y-m-59-11.title: Ingaba inkcazelo isonjululwe ngokupheleleyo ngenxa nje yokuba kufunyenwe izisombululo ezimbini?
y-m-59-11.goal: Yazi ukuba izisombululo zinokunyamalala ngelixa utshintsha inkcazelo, uze ugweba inani lezisombululo ngokuthelekisa iindlela ezahlukeneyo ezingalahli izisombululo kwixesha.
y-m-59-11.material:
Ufuna ukufumana izisombululo zenkcazelo sin x = sin 2x kwi-0 ≤ x ≤ 2π (zombini iziphelo ziqukiwe, bala x njengamanani okwenyani ahlukeneyo). (Ukufunda: sine x ilingana ne-sine 2x.) UJimin wasombulula ngolu hlobo.

"Wahlula amacala omabini nge-sin x ukufumana 1 = 2 cos x, ngoko cos x = 1/2. Kwi-0 ≤ x ≤ 2π, ii-x ezino-cos x = 1/2 zi-π/3 kunye no-5π/3, ngoko zikho izisombululo ezimbini."
y-m-59-11.prereq.0: 'H2' yalo msebenzi luphawu lobunzima nenqanaba lenkxaso yeli qela lemveliso kuphela; ayithethi ukuba iSebe lezeMfundo limisela ikharityhulam kwibanga elithile. Ingcinga: isonjululwa ngumfundi osele efunde isiqulatho esingezantsi.
y-m-59-11.prereq.1: Amaxabiso neegrafu zemisebenzi ye-trigonometric (sin, cos kwi-0 ≤ x ≤ 2π)
y-m-59-11.prereq.2: Ifomyula yeengile ezi-double sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x
y-m-59-11.s.s1.prompt: Idatha iyatyhilwa isiqwenga ngexesha. Ngalo lonke ixesha, khetha ingcinga yakho malunga nesisombululo sikaJimin.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.hint.0: Faka ulwazi olutsha lwenyathelo ngalinye ngokuthe ngqo kwinkcazelo yokuqala sin x = sin 2x.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.hint.1: Khangela amaxabiso kwixesha apho inani olihlula ngalo linokuba yi-0.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.info: Isisombululo sikaJimin sinjengangasentla. Ukuba ufaka izisombululo ezimbini π/3 no-5π/3 kwinkcazelo yokuqala, ziyabamba ngokwenene.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.ask: Ugweba njani isigqibo sikaJimin 'zikho izisombululo ezimbini ncam'?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.after: Siqinisekisile ukuba izisombululo ezimbini ziyabamba, kodwa kuba amacala omabini ahlulwe nge-sin x, amathuba okuba izisombululo zinyamalale akazahlolwa okwangoku.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kulungile. Wahlula wasombulula, kwaye izisombululo ezimbini ziyabamba, ngoko zikho izisombululo ezimbini ncam
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Ucinge ukuba into yokuba izisombululo ezimbini ziyabamba iqinisekise nesigqibo 'akukho nto enye'. Ukufumana izisombululo ezibambayo kwahlukile ekufumaneni zonke izisombululo.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Zikho izisombululo ezingaphantsi kwezimbini. Esinye kuphela esichanekileyo
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kunikiwe ukuba zombini izisombululo ziyabamba. Iphikisana nolwazi olunikiweyo.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Izisombululo ezifunyenweyo zichanekile, kodwa kusenokubakho izisombululo ezilahlekileyo, ngoko uhlolo luyafuneka
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wahlukanise isisombululo esibambayo ne-'wafumene zonke izisombululo'. Isimo sengqondo sokuhlola ukuba kukho nto itshintshayo ngexesha lotshintsho.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Asinakwazi ngaphandle kokubala ukudibana ngokuthe ngqo kwigrafu
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Ucebise indlela yokuhlola ngokuthe ngqo endaweni yokuvakalisa kwisisombululo kuphela. Cinga ukuba ingahlolwa ngendlela yealgebra nayo.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.info: Ulwazi olutsha: ukuba ufaka x = 0 kwinkcazelo yokuqala, sin 0 = 0 kwaye sin 0 = 0, ngoko iyabamba. Ukuba ufaka x = π, sin π = 0 kwaye sin 2π = 0, ngoko iyabamba.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.ask: Isigwebo sakho sesisombululo sikaJimin sitshintsha njani ngolu lwazi?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.after: x = 0 no-x = π zanelisa inkcazelo yokuqala, ngoko zizisombululo. Ukuhlula amacala omabini nge-sin x, sin x ≠ 0 iyafuneka, kodwa ukwahlula akuvunyelwa kwi-x ene-sin x = 0 (0, π, 2π), ngoko loo meko kufuneka ihlolwe ngokwahlukileyo.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.a: x = 0 no-x = π ziyabamba ngokuhlangana, ngoko akukho sidingo sokuzibala njengezisombululo
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ukuba iyabamba xa ifakwa kwinkcazelo yokuqala, sisisombululo. Cinga ukuba likho na ixabiso lokucoca isisombululo njengokuhlangana.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Ulwazi olutsha ngolokuba zikho ezinye izisombululo, hayi ukuba izisombululo zikaJimin ziphosakele.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Isigqibo sikaJimin siphosakele. Kunokwenzeka kakhulu ukuba izisombululo ezino-sin x = 0 zanyamalala xa kwahlulwa
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Udibanise ukuba kutheni izisombululo zinokunyamalala ekwahluleni. Ulungisile isigwebo sakho ngokusekelwe kulwazi olutsha lokuba uhlole ngokufaka amaxabiso abambayo.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Awuhlolanga ukuba ulwazi olutsha luyalushukumisa na 'ezimbini kanye'. Bala kwakhona ukuba zingaphi izisombululo.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.info: Ulwazi olutsha: sin x − sin 2x = sin x − 2 sin x cos x = sin x (1 − 2 cos x). Ukuze oku kube ngu-0, okanye sin x = 0 okanye 1 − 2 cos x = 0 kufuneka kusebenze.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.ask: Zingaphi izisombululo olu lingano oluzinazo zizonke kwi-0 ≤ x ≤ 2π?
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.after: Ukuba sin x = 0, ngoko x = 0, π, 2π, kwaye ukuba cos x = 1/2, ngoko x = π/3, 5π/3. Akukho maxabiso agqithisanayo, ngoko zingama-5 zizonke. (Ukuba ixesha bekuyi-0 ≤ x < 2π, u-2π uyashiywa, enze ama-4.)
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Awubalanga izisombululo zemeko sin x = 0, okanye walandela nje isigqibo sikaJimin. Fumana u-x ono-sin x = 0 kuxesha.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Le yimeko apho iziphelo zexesha u-0 no-2π zabalwa njengechaphaza elinye. Lo msebenzi wathi bala u-x njengamanani enyani ahlukeneyo.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Usenokuba ubale izisombululo kabini. Bhala uluhlu lwezisombululo zemeko nganye enye ngenye kuxesha uze uhlole ukuba ikhona na amaxabiso agqithisanayo.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Udibanise izisombululo ezine-sin x = 0 (0, π, 2π) nezisombululo ezine-cos x = 1/2 (π/3, 5π/3). Wahlule iimeko wabala nganye ngokwahlukeneyo.
y-m-59-11.s.s1.reflect: Ekuqaleni, wagweba njani xa ubona 'zombini izisombululo ziyasebenza', kwaye kwatshintsha ntoni emva kokubona ulwazi olutsha? 'Izisombululo ezifunyenweyo zichanekile' zahluka njani kwi 'zonke izisombululo zifunyenwe'?
y-m-59-11.s.s2.prompt: Khetha zonke iindlela ezinokusetyenziswa ukuze zingalahleki izisombululo kuxesha.

y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.a: Le yindlela esingatha ngokwahlukeneyo imeko apho inani owahlula ngalo li-0. Ukuba uyishiyile le ndlela, cinga ukuba kufuneka uhlole ntoni phambi kokwahlula.

y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.c: Izisombululo ezimbini ziphumile, ngoko cinga ukuba kwanele uze ugqibe isisombululo ngoko nangoko
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.c: Ugwebe ukuba iphelele ngenani lezisombululo ezifunyenweyo. Ukuba izisombululo ezifunyenweyo ziyasebenza kwahlukile ekubeni zonke izisombululo zifunyenwe.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.d: Zoba iigrafu zemisebenzi emibini uze ubale inani lamachaphaza okudibana
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.d: Le yindlela ehlola izisombululo ngamachaphaza okudibana egrafu endaweni yokubala ngealgebra. Ukuba uyishiyile le ndlela, cinga ukuba izisombululo zolingano zingantoni kwigrafu.
y-m-59-11.s.s2.o.e: Wahlula macala omabini ngo-sin x ucombulule, uze wongeze u-x = 0 kuphela njengesisombululo esilahlekileyo
y-m-59-11.s.s2.r.e: Usilungisile isiqingatha sezisombululo ezilahlekileyo kuphela. Fumana onke ama-x kuxesha ane-sin x = 0.

y-m-59-08.goal: Kwisisombululo esisebenzisa iimpawu ze-sigma, fumana umgca owaphatha ngokungalunganga isixa segama elingatshintshiyo, uhlukanise ixabiso (n = 1) apho intetho engalunganga yenzeka ibonakala ilungile nexabiso elityhila impazamo, uze ulungise indlela yokuhlola.
y-m-59-08.material: UHayun wabhala ixabiso le-Σ_{k=1}^{n} (2k + 1) njengentetho ye-n. (Ukufunda: sigma, k ukusuka kwi-1 ukuya kwi-n, 2k kunye no-1. Oko kukuthi isixa 3 + 5 + 7 + … + (2n + 1).) Ekupheleni kwesisombululo, uHayun wabhala, "Ndifake n = 1 kwaye ilingana ne-3, isixa endisifumene ngokuthe ngqo, ngoko kulungile."

y-m-59-13.title: Ukuba ixabiso lelogarithm likhulu, ingaba ingxoxo nayo inkulu?
y-m-59-13.goal: Qinisekisa ngeemeko ukuba ukuthelekisa ubukhulu bamalogarithm kuxhomekeke koluhlu lwesiseko, chaza imeko apho isibakala 'ukuba ixabiso lelog likhulu, x naye mkhulu' sisebenza khona, uze wenze ngokwakho imizekelo yeemeko ezimbini.
y-m-59-13.material:
UJaehee wathi, "Ukuba log_a x > log_a 3, ngoko x > 3." (Ukufunda: ukuba log isiseko a ka-x likhulu kuno-log isiseko a ka-3.) Isiseko a singu-a > 0, a ≠ 1, kwaye ingxoxo x ingu-x > 0.

Itheyibhile inamaxabiso ambalwa.
Isiseko 2: log_2 1 = 0, log_2 2 = 1, log_2 4 = 2, log_2 3 ≈ 1.58
Isiseko 1/2: log_(1/2) 1 = 0, log_(1/2) 2 = −1, log_(1/2) 4 = −2, log_(1/2) 3 ≈ −1.58

y-m-59-01.goal: Yazi ukuba xa izikhuphi zandiswa ukusuka kumanani emvelo ziye ku-0 nakumanani aphelele anegethivu, ixabiso alimiselwa ngokungenasizathu kodwa ngemeko ethi 'gcina imithetho esele ikhona yezikhuphi', uze ugwebe ukuba kutheni indlela efanayo ibambeka xa isiseko singu-0.
y-m-59-01.material:
Izikhuphi zika-2 zibhaliwe kwitheyibhile. Cinga ukuba iimeko apho isikhuphi singu-0 okanye sinegethivu zingekamiselwa.

Isikhuphi: 4, 3, 2, 1
Ixabiso:   16, 8, 4, 2

(Funda njenge: isikhuphi 4 sinika 16, isikhuphi 3 sinika 8, njalo njalo.) Masicinge inyathelo ngenyathelo ukuba ixabiso kufuneka limiselwe njani xa isikhuphi singu-0, −1, …. Qala ucinge ngemeko apho isiseko singu-2.

y-m-59-04.title: Xa pH isuka ku-3 iye ku-6, ubuhlungu be-asidi buba buthambile kangaphi?
y-m-59-04.goal: Funda kwidatha indlela umahluko wenani elinye kwisikali selogarithm oguqulwa ngayo ube 'ngamaxesha', uze ugatye ibango elitolika ngokungalunganga umlinganiselo wamanani esikali njengomlinganiselo wokuxinana.
y-m-59-04.material:
Masifunde nge-pH, ebonisa amandla e-asidi. Kulo msebenzi, sivuma ukuba kwisisombululo samanzi esinqabileyo ukuxinana kwe-ion ye-hydrogen [H⁺] (iyunithi mol/L, 'iimole ngeelitha') imiselwe yi-[H⁺] = 10^(−pH). (Ukufunda: 10 ukuya kumandla ayi-pH ebi)

Isisombululo | pH | [H⁺] (mol/L)
A | 3 | 0.001
B | 4 | 0.0001
C | 6 | 0.000001

UDonghyun wathi, "I-pH ye-C iphindaphindwe ka-2 i-pH ye-A, ngoko C ayinabuhlungu be-asidi ngokuphindwe ka-2 kune-A."

y-m-59-04.s.s1.explain: 0.001 ÷ 0.0001 = 10 kunye 0.001 ÷ 0.000001 = 1000. Xa i-pH inyuka nge-1, i-[H⁺] iba yishumi, yaye xa inyuka nge-3, iba yinxalenye eyi-1000. Ayithabathi isixa esifanayo; incipha ngomlinganiselo ofanayo.
y-m-59-04.s.s2.prompt: Ufuna ukukhetha amaxabiso e-pH ukuze i-[H⁺] yezisombululo ezimbini ihluke ngamaxesha ayi-1000 kanye. Vumela i-pH yesisombululo esixineneyo ngakumbi ibe yi-p kwaye i-pH yesisombululo esinqabileyo ngakumbi ibe yi-q (0 ≤ p, q ≤ 14), uze wenze izibini ezintathu ezahlukeneyo (p, q) apho i-[H⁺] yesisombululo se-pH p ilingana kanye nokuphindwe ka-1000 i-[H⁺] yesisombululo se-pH q. (i-pH akufuneki ibe linani eliphelele. Ukuba p iyahluka, ngumzekelo owahlukileyo.)

y-m-59-05.topic: Ukwenza imodeli yeziganeko ezibuyelelayo ngegrafu zemisebenzi ye-trigonometri
y-m-59-05.goal: Xa ubhala ubude behamba ngokuphindaphindiweyo kwintetho yohlobo lwekhosayini, hlola inkqubo apho iziko, ubukhulu bokushukuma kunye nokuhambisa zigqitywa yimiqathango, uze wakhe ngokwakho iintetho ezimbini ezahlukeneyo (ezinemiqondiso eyahlukileyo) ezanelisa imiqathango.
y-m-59-05.material:
Ivili lamandla likhawuleza ngesantya esizinzileyo, lijike ngokupheleleyo kanye kwiisekondi ezingama-60. Indawo esezantsi ingama-2 m ngaphezu komhlaba yaye indawo ephezulu ingama-30 m ngaphezu komhlaba. Vumela umzuzu lapho umkhweli engena ube ngu-t = 0 iisekondi, xa umkhweli esendaweni esezantsi.

Yenza imodeli yobude bomkhweli (iyunithi m) njenge-h(t) = D + A·cos(2π(t − c)/60). (Ukufundwa: ikhosayini ye-2 pi ephindaphindwe nge-t ukuncitshiswa nge-c ngaphezulu kwamashumi amathandathu) I-D bubude beziko, i-A linani elimisela ubukhulu bokushukuma (linokuba negatifu), yaye i-c yimali ehanjiswe ngasekunene (iisekondi). Yinciphisele ku-0 ≤ c < 60.
